finding.title: Calendar days or 30 days
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a purge of records older than 30 times 24 hours (`Records are kept for 30 days.`, S:23), and that is wrong because 30 days may mean one calendar month.

e1.context:
